definition_en: Install all drainage pipes, floor drain bodies and WC collars inside slabs/walls before any covering work.

checklist.text_en: Pipe routes match approved plumbing layout
Horizontal runs sloped 2% (pipes <= 110 mm)
Floor drains at lowest point of planned floor slope
Vent pipes connected and extended to riser/roof
Open pipe ends capped against debris

completion_criteria: All drainage points from layout exist on site
Water test held 24h with no level drop
Site engineer sign-off recorded

required_photos.description_en: All drainage routes photographed before covering

inspection_items: Slope verified with level on every horizontal run
Joint solvent welds continuous
No sharp 90° bends on horizontal WC runs (use 45° pairs)

definition_en: Install PPR/PEX hot and cold supply lines, manifolds and angle-valve points to every fixture position.

checklist.text_en: Every fixture from kb_plumbing_standards has supply points at listed heights
Hot line on the left of each point pair
Hot lines insulated along full run
Point pairs 15-20 cm apart, level

completion_criteria: All points match fixture schedule
Lines anchored every 1 m
No joints buried without test

required_photos.description_en: Supply routes in every wet wall before plaster

inspection_items: Heights match standard (basin 55-60, shower mixer 100-110, WC/shattaf 60)
Crossovers use bridge fittings, not stacked pipes

definition_en: Pressurize supply network to 1.5x working pressure (min 10 bar) and hold to prove joint integrity before covering.

checklist.text_en: Calibrated gauge installed at manifold
System pumped to 10 bar minimum
Pressure held 24 hours
Start/end readings photographed with timestamps

completion_criteria: Pressure drop <= 0.2 bar over 24h
Test certificate uploaded
Consultant/engineer witness recorded

required_photos.description_en: Gauge at test start with visible reading

inspection_items: Gauge calibration valid
All branch valves open during test
Result recorded against unit, not project only

definition_en: Install sanitary ware, mixers, accessories and connect to tested rough-in points.

checklist.text_en: Basins/WCs level and sealed with sanitary silicone
Installed positions respect clearance standards
All traps installed and holding water seal
Water heaters mounted with drain pan piped

completion_criteria: Every fixture operates without leak at full pressure
Silicone joints continuous and tooled
Protective films removed only after handover cleaning
inspection_items: No flexible hose under permanent tension
Wall-hung WC torque per carrier spec
Angle valves accessible, not painted over

definition_en: Full-system operational test: flow, drainage speed, hot water delivery, leak audit under use conditions.

checklist.text_en: Every outlet delivers steady flow, both temperatures
Basins/showers drain without pooling
Hot water reaches farthest outlet in acceptable time
Cabinet interiors and ceilings dry after 48h of use

completion_criteria: Zero active leaks
Drainage odor traps sealed
Handover checklist signed
inspection_items: Check under-sink cabinets with dry tissue
Confirm floor drains hold water seal
Water heater relief valve discharges to drain

definition_en: Chase walls/slabs, install conduits and back boxes for all points per the approved electrical layout.

checklist.text_en: Box positions/heights match kb_electrical_standards
Power and data conduits separated (min 20 cm parallel runs)
Bends use springs/long radius — no crushed conduits
Back boxes flush with finished plaster plane, level

completion_criteria: Point count per room >= layout count
Draw wires present in every conduit
Chases closed with mortar, not gypsum

required_photos.description_en: Conduited walls per room before plaster

inspection_items: Socket boxes at 30 cm, switches 110 cm, counter sockets 110 cm
Kitchen appliance circuits have their own conduits
Bathroom boxes outside shower splash zone

definition_en: Pull all circuits: lighting 2x1.5 + E, sockets 2x2.5 + E, AC/heater per dedicated schedule, data cat6.

checklist.text_en: Cable sizes match circuit schedule (1.5 lighting / 2.5 sockets / 4-6 AC-oven)
Earth conductor present in every circuit
Consistent phase/neutral/earth colors throughout
15-20 cm slack coiled in each box

completion_criteria: Continuity test passed per circuit
No joints inside conduits — junctions only in boxes
Circuit register filled (room → breaker)
inspection_items: Megger insulation test >= 1 MΩ per circuit
Data cables untwisted <13 mm at terminations
No power/data sharing a box without divider

definition_en: Install DB, RCDs and breakers; terminate and label every circuit.

checklist.text_en: RCD 30 mA protection on socket and wet-area circuits
Breaker ratings match cable sizes (16A/2.5mm², 20A/4mm², 32A/6mm²)
Every breaker labeled in Arabic + English
Loads balanced across phases (3-phase supplies)

completion_criteria: Torque check on all terminals
Main earth bar connected to earthing system
DB schedule card printed and fixed inside door
inspection_items: RCD test button trips correctly
No double-lugged breakers
Spare ways >= 20%

definition_en: Fit final wiring accessories, plates, and smart devices after painting final coat.

checklist.text_en: Plates level and flush, no plaster gaps
Correct polarity at every socket (tester)
Smart switches have neutral at the box
Child-safe shuttered sockets in kids rooms

completion_criteria: Every point from layout is fitted and functional
Two-way circuits switch from both ends
USB outlets deliver rated current

required_photos.description_en: Accessory walls per room after fit

inspection_items: Socket tester on 100% of sockets
Dimmers matched to LED load type
Plate alignment across vertical stacks

definition_en: Full installation test: insulation, earth loop, RCD times, functional test of every point; issue completion certificate.

checklist.text_en: Insulation resistance recorded per circuit
Earth loop impedance within breaker disconnect limits
RCD trip times <= 300 ms at 1x, <= 40 ms at 5x
Every light, socket and smart device operated

completion_criteria: Test sheet uploaded with instrument readings
Zero outstanding electrical snags
Certificate signed by qualified electrician
inspection_items: Readings match circuit register
Verify labels against actual rooms
Confirm isolation switches for AC/heaters function

definition_en: Run insulated refrigerant pairs, condensate drains (sloped) and power provisions from indoor unit positions to outdoor locations.

checklist.text_en: Suction and liquid lines individually insulated, joints taped
Condensate drain slope >= 1% to approved discharge
Condensate trap at unit per manufacturer
Pipe lengths within unit max run/lift limits

completion_criteria: Drain lines water-tested before ceiling closes
Pipe ends sealed and pressurized with holding charge/nitrogen
Routes photographed before covering

required_photos.description_en: Pipe and drain routes above ceiling line
Water poured in drain pan/line during test

inspection_items: No kinked copper bends
Drain does not tie into soil stack without trap/air gap
Wall sleeves sealed

definition_en: Install supply/return ducting, dampers and grille frames for concealed duct units.

checklist.text_en: Duct sizes match design airflow
Ducts insulated/lined, joints sealed with mastic
Return air path sized — no starved returns
Access panels at dampers, coils and drain pans

completion_criteria: Grille frame positions coordinated with gypsum design
No flexible duct runs > 1.5 m or crushed bends
Leak check at joints
inspection_items: Coordination with lighting layout signed
Fire damper where duct crosses rated walls
Return grille not opposite supply (short-circuit airflow)

definition_en: Mount indoor/outdoor units, vacuum lines, release/charge refrigerant, connect drains and controls.

checklist.text_en: System vacuumed to <= 500 microns and held
Outdoor unit on anti-vibration mounts with service clearance
Refrigerant charge per line-length calculation
Thermostats mounted 150 cm, away from supply air draft

completion_criteria: Vacuum decay test recorded
Condensate flows at unit with test pour
Controls respond from thermostat
inspection_items: Flare torque per spec — no flare paste as leak fix
Outdoor discharge clearance >= 60 cm
Drain pan clean of construction debris

definition_en: Run all units at design load; verify temperatures, airflow, drainage and noise before ceiling close-out sign-off.

checklist.text_en: Supply/return ΔT within 8-12°C at steady state
All grilles deliver design airflow
Continuous drain test — 30 min run with dry ceiling
No abnormal vibration/noise at any speed

completion_criteria: Commissioning sheet with readings uploaded
Client walkthrough of thermostat use done
inspection_items: Amp draw vs nameplate
Insulation continuous at unit connections (no sweating)
Filters clean at handover

definition_en: Clean substrate, fix mesh at material junctions, set plumb screed points and bands defining the finished plaster plane.

checklist.text_en: Galvanized mesh over chases and block/concrete junctions
Screed points plumb and aligned wall-to-wall
Spatterdash/bonding coat on smooth concrete
All MEP chases closed and inspected before plaster

completion_criteria: Plumb check every wall <= 5 mm total deviation
Right angles verified at corners (3-4-5)
inspection_items: No plaster over untested plumbing lines
Door/window opening dimensions rechecked against schedule

definition_en: Apply cement plaster coats to walls and ceilings to screed plane; internal 15-20 mm typical.

checklist.text_en: Thickness 15-20 mm; over 25 mm applied in two coats with mesh
2 m straightedge gap <= 3 mm anywhere
External corners with corner beads, crisp arris
Reveals square and even around doors/windows

completion_criteria: Full coverage, no hollow-sounding areas on tap test
Openings match carpentry schedule ±5 mm
inspection_items: Tap survey for hollows
Straightedge and plumb spot checks
No cracks at junction mesh zones

definition_en: Water-cure plaster 3-7 days, then survey and repair shrinkage cracks before any painting starts.

checklist.text_en: Walls wetted 2x daily for min 3 days (climate-adjusted)
Crack survey after 7 days, marked on walls
Cracks raked and refilled, hollows re-done

completion_criteria: No active cracking two weeks after repair
Moisture content < 12% before paint (protimeter)
inspection_items: Moisture reading logged per room
Repairs flush after drying

definition_en: Set out ceiling levels and install channels/hangers per the approved ceiling design, coordinated with all above-ceiling services.

checklist.text_en: Perimeter level lasered; design heights per drawing
Hangers max 120 cm spacing, anchored to slab (never to ducts/pipes)
Frame openings for AC grilles, curtains, access hatches set out
Cove/tray dimensions fit LED strip + driver access

completion_criteria: MEP above ceiling tested and signed BEFORE closing starts
Frame rigid — no deflection under hand pressure

required_photos.description_en: Frame with services above, before boarding

inspection_items: Nothing suspended from HVAC/plumbing
Curtain box width fits track type (min 15 cm single, 20 cm double)

definition_en: Fix gypsum boards, moisture-resistant grade in wet areas, staggered joints, screwed at 15-20 cm.

checklist.text_en: Green (MR) board in bathrooms, kitchen, laundry
Board joints staggered, no cross joints
Screws at 15-20 cm, heads dimpled not broken through paper
Downlight/grille cutouts per lighting layout, clean holes

completion_criteria: All boards fixed, no unsupported edges
Access hatches installed at every concealed valve/unit
inspection_items: MR board verified by edge color in wet rooms
Hatch positions match valve/AC locations

definition_en: Tape joints, fill fastener heads, finish to Level 4 (Level 5 skim where grazing light or gloss paint planned).

checklist.text_en: All joints taped (paper/fiber), corners beaded
Three-coat system, sanded between coats
Skim coat where cove lighting washes the surface

completion_criteria: No visible joints under raking light test
Surface dust-free ready for primer
inspection_items: Raking light (LED held flat to surface) shows no ridges
Cove internal corners crisp and straight

definition_en: Install access panels, verify every concealed serviceable item is reachable, cut any missed openings.

checklist.text_en: Hatch map cross-checked against valve/unit register
Hatches min 30x30 cm (60x60 at AC units/heaters)
Panels flush, paintable, gasketed in wet areas

completion_criteria: Every angle valve, damper, driver and heater reachable
Hatch schedule photographed and archived
inspection_items: Open every hatch and touch the item it serves
LED drivers not sealed inside coves without access

definition_en: Apply waterproof membrane to wet-area floors and walls (min 30 cm up walls; 180 cm in shower zones), then flood test.

checklist.text_en: Substrate clean, cracks pre-filled, corners coved/taped
Two coats applied in perpendicular directions
30 cm wall upstand; 180 cm in shower wet wall; door threshold wrapped
48h flood test with marked water level

completion_criteria: Zero level drop and no dampness below after 48h
Membrane continuous at drains (clamped/collared)

required_photos.description_en: Membrane coverage incl. upstands before test
Flood test with level mark, start and end

inspection_items: Puncture check before covering
Drain collar integration correct
Test result recorded per room

definition_en: Lay leveling screed to design FFL minus finish thickness; fall to drains in wet areas.

checklist.text_en: FFL datum transferred to every room; screed = FFL - finish build-up
Wet areas fall 1.5-2% to floor drains, verified with water
3 mm / 2 m for large-format tile zones
Cured min 7 days before tiling

completion_criteria: Water poured at door reaches drain in every wet room
No cracking/hollowness after cure
inspection_items: Straightedge survey logged
Thickness min 25 mm bonded / 50 mm unbonded

definition_en: Install tile/stone/wood floors per layout drawings: centered layouts, aligned joints, full adhesive coverage.

checklist.text_en: Dry-lay approved: centered on room or per drawing, cuts balanced at edges
Back-buttered large formats; >= 90% adhesive coverage (lift test)
Lippage <= 1 mm (leveling clips on large format)
Joint width consistent (2-3 mm rectified); expansion joints at 25 m² fields and doorways
Finished floors boarded/covered immediately

completion_criteria: Tap test: no hollow tiles (max 5% corner hollowness tolerated)
Joints aligned through doorways where drawings require
inspection_items: Random lift test at start of work
Slope preserved to drains after tiling
Wood/SPC expansion gaps at perimeter 8-10 mm

definition_en: Grout joints, seal movement joints with matching sealant, install skirting.

checklist.text_en: Joints full and flush, color per approval, cleaned before cure
Silicone (not grout) at all floor-wall junctions in wet areas
Skirting level, scribed to floor, mitred corners

completion_criteria: No grout voids on raking inspection
Skirting-to-wall gap caulked ready for paint touch-up

required_photos.description_en: Grout and skirting details at corners

inspection_items: Wet-area junctions flexible-sealed
Grout sealed on natural stone

definition_en: Apply 2-3 putty coats to plaster and gypsum, sanding between coats to a defect-free plane.

checklist.text_en: Substrate moisture < 12% before starting
Minimum 2 coats, full coverage including reveals
Sanded with lamp check — no scratches, pits or joints visible

completion_criteria: Raking-light inspection passed on 100% of surfaces
All MEP boxes masked, not filled over
inspection_items: Random scrape adhesion check
Edges and arrises still crisp, not rounded by sanding

definition_en: Apply pigmented primer-sealer to all puttied surfaces to unify absorption and reveal remaining defects.

checklist.text_en: Uniform single coat, no misses (check against raw putty color)
Defects highlighted by primer re-filled and re-primed

completion_criteria: No suction differences visible when half-dry
Surfaces dust-free after final sand
inspection_items: Primer compatible with topcoat system
No primer on hardware/glass (masking intact)

definition_en: Apply first finish coat in approved colors; cut lines at ceilings and color changes.

checklist.text_en: Colors match approved schedule per room (verify code on can)
Straight cut lines at ceiling and feature walls
Even film, no runs/roller marks after leveling

completion_criteria: Full coverage, minor grinning acceptable before final coat only
inspection_items: Wet film thickness spot check
Ventilation during application

definition_en: Apply final coat after all wet/dusty trades finish; touch up after accessory and carpentry installation.

checklist.text_en: Applied AFTER tiling, gypsum, and carpentry sanding are complete
Uniform sheen, no patchiness under daylight and artificial light
Post-fit-out touch-ups blended, not patch-visible

completion_criteria: Client-light inspection (day + night) passed
Leftover labeled paint (min 1L per color) handed to client
inspection_items: Sheen uniformity at grazing angles
Cut lines at cove lighting edges perfect (light magnifies)

definition_en: Install door frames plumb/square, anchored and foamed, before final plaster/paint interfaces.

checklist.text_en: Frames plumb both axes <= 2 mm; diagonals equal
Head height uniform across floor (laser)
Min 3 anchors per jamb + PU foam continuous
Frames wrapped until final paint

completion_criteria: Opening sizes leave 3-4 mm leaf gaps
Wet-area frames are WPC/aluminum or fully sealed

required_photos.description_en: Installed frames with level on jamb

inspection_items: Frame material vs room type (no MDF in bathrooms)
Floor finish thickness accounted in frame height

definition_en: Hang leaves, fit locks/hinges/stoppers, align gaps, adjust closing action.

checklist.text_en: Even 3 mm gaps at head/sides; 8-10 mm floor clearance (more if carpet)
Locks latch smoothly; keys/cards handed over labeled
Door stoppers placed — no handle hits a wall
Swing direction matches layout (into rooms, not blocking switches)

completion_criteria: Every door closes with soft push, no scraping
Privacy locks on bathrooms/bedrooms function

required_photos.description_en: Hung doors closed, gap lines visible

inspection_items: Hinge screws full-set, not partial
Handle height uniform 100-105 cm
Door undercut allows return air where AC design requires

definition_en: Install wardrobes, vanities and built-ins: leveled carcasses, aligned fronts, adjusted hardware.

checklist.text_en: Carcasses leveled at base (laser) before joining
Filler panels scribed to walls/ceiling — no open gaps
Door/drawer fronts co-planar, equal reveals
Tall units anchored to wall (tip-over)

completion_criteria: All drawers/doors operate silently full-travel
Soft-close engaged on all fronts
Interiors clean, protective film removed
inspection_items: Back panels don't trap sockets — cutouts with access
Hanging rail heights per standard (100/200 cm double hang)

definition_en: Install kitchen cabinets, countertop templating/fitting, appliance integration, final sealing.

checklist.text_en: Base run level within 2 mm over full length
Cutouts for sink/hob/services precise; edges sealed
Countertop seams tight, silicone at wall junction
Appliances fitted, doors aligned, ventilation gaps per spec

completion_criteria: Sink/hob/dishwasher operational after install
Water test under sink 24h dry
All shelves/accessories delivered
inspection_items: Hob-to-hood distance 65-75 cm
Cutout edges in worktop sealed against swelling
Anti-tip brackets on tall oven housings

definition_en: Install downlights, strips, pendants and feature fixtures per lighting layout after final paint.

checklist.text_en: Fixture positions match layout (spacing/wall offset per standard)
LED strips continuous, drivers accessible, no visible dots/joints in coves
Pendants centered on furniture positions at spec heights
Chandeliers on rated anchors to slab, not to gypsum

completion_criteria: Every fixture from layout installed and lit
Consistent color temperature within each room (verify bin/CCT)

required_photos.description_en: Each room with all layers on

inspection_items: Mixed CCT check (one 4000K spot in a 3000K room is a snag)
Cove strip visible-dot check at eye level
Driver hum test in silent room

definition_en: Commission smart switches/hub, create scenes, bind sensors, hand over app access.

checklist.text_en: All smart devices joined to hub, named per room (AR + EN)
Agreed scenes programmed (welcome/away/night/movie)
Motion sensor zones and timeouts configured
Physical switches still operate lights if hub offline

completion_criteria: Client app account is owner (not installer account)
Scene walkthrough done with client

required_photos.description_en: App dashboard showing all rooms online

inspection_items: Hub offline test — manual control works
Naming matches room signage/drawings

definition_en: Aim adjustable fixtures, verify lux levels against standards, resolve snags, complete photometric handover.

checklist.text_en: Lux measured at working plane per room vs kb_lighting_standards
Adjustable spots aimed at art/features, not into eyes/screens
Dimming smooth full-range, no flicker at low end
Switch functions labeled/explained to client

completion_criteria: Measured lux within min-max band in every room
Zero flickering fixtures (slow-mo phone camera test)
Snag list closed

required_photos.description_en: Lux meter readings in key rooms

inspection_items: Flicker test on all dimmed circuits
Verify IP-rated fittings actually installed in wet zones
Emergency/night pathways acceptable
